notes.title: Graphical Overhaul!
notes.content:
We realllllllly liked how it looked before, however, much like an ugly baby, we were blind to the atrocity that it was... Well, actually, we knew it looked bad.

At White Mage Games, we want to maintain a standard for our games, we want them to be polished in every aspect, and much like the functionality being flawless, so too must the graphics.

After several weeks of continuous work, we have reached a stage that after much scrutiny, had us remake a lot of the textures, change a lot of the models, add a whole load more models, and finally escape the hell-scape that was Unity's Universal Render Pipeline for the much more beautiful High Definition Render Pipeline.

We wanted to make this change to the HDRP over the URP much earlier in development, however, we ran into a mass of problems with Unity's VR compatibility with HDRP. It became a buggy mess and was essentially unplayable, now though, we have the freedom to create freely, and also, once Unity has fixed their sh*t further, be able to enable full RTX support!

notes.title: Wishlist Typo today!
notes.content:
It's official! You can now officially follow a product that you have no way of purchasing. What a beautiful world we live in!

Seriously though, you might just enjoy what you see... whilst we can't promise erotic imagery, due to Steam's Community Guidelines (we know, so dumb...), we do promise some saucy content for your lil' eyeballs to enjoy.

Hit that green button and you can keep up-to-date with all the beautiful updates that we know you'll love.

notes.title: We got social media!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone! 

Thanks for taking the time to look at our first ever game, although we're not released yet, we have created social media accounts for you! to follow and to keep up to date with our progress, and also to get involved before the release of early access! Got some cool dialogue you think will work well? A new character to introduce into the story, or even a little feature you'd like to see implemented in a VR narrative game. we are all open ears!

So come take a look! the accounts may look empty for now (we've just created them, we know we're slow.... Game development takes a lot of time and effort!). We'll be posting regularly with polls and progress reports along the way!
